纪玉金老师课题组隶属于苏州大学功能纳米与软物质研究院李有勇教授课题组，核心研究方: The Yujin Ji Research Group is part of Prof. Youyong Li's group at the Institute of Functional Nano & Soft Materials (FUNSOM), Soochow University. We focus on the theoretical simulation and design of two-dimensional materials for energy storage and conversion. Through multiscale modeling, we investigate how surface atomic structures and morphologies evolve, uncover surface reaction mechanisms, and connect atomic and electronic structure with material performance. Combining these insights with databases of two-dimensional materials, we conduct high-throughput screening, material design, and performance optimization to guide the development of new energy materials.

Ground-state optimization cannot replace excited-state dynamics in photochemistry. Tunneling and zero-point motion of light nuclei are not automatically included in classical geometry optimization. A harmonic oscillator, for example, has zero-point energy ½ℏω. Calling the minimum electronic energy an experimental energy that includes all thermal effects would therefore be misleading.
普通函数 f(x) 把一个数变成另一个数；能量泛函 E[n] 把整个空间的密度分: An ordinary function f(x) maps one number to another; an energy functional E[n] maps an entire spatial density distribution to an energy. Ground-state DFT states that, under appropriate conditions, the ground-state electron density determines the external potential and the system's ground-state properties. The exact ground-state energy follows from a variational search over admissible densities. This existence theorem does not supply a practical exact functional, nor does it make every arbitrarily drawn density physically admissible.
Kohn–Sham 本征值属于辅助体系，任意两个能级的差不普遍等于实验激发能。常: Kohn–Sham eigenvalues belong to an auxiliary system. Differences between arbitrary pairs of eigenvalues do not generally equal experimental excitation energies. Common semilocal functionals underestimate the band gaps of many semiconductors, but there is no theorem that DFT underestimates every gap. The fundamental gap involves the energies of adding and removing electrons. Optical excitations also depend on electron–hole interactions, selection rules, temperature, and other factors. Always state which quantity you are comparing.
电子是费米子，交换两个电子坐标时多电子波函数必须反号。Hartree–Fock（: Electrons are fermions: exchanging the coordinates of two electrons must reverse the sign of the many-electron wavefunction. Hartree–Fock (HF) enforces this antisymmetry with a Slater determinant of spin orbitals, then optimizes the orbitals variationally. Each electron moves in the mean field of the others. The determinant produces exchange terms that constrain the joint distribution of same-spin electrons. Exchange is not a mechanical process of two small balls swapping positions, and HF does not ignore electron–electron repulsion.
密度决定有效势，有效势又决定轨道，轨道再产生密度，所以方程必须自洽求解。实际杂化: The density determines the effective potential; the potential determines the orbitals; the orbitals generate a new density. These equations therefore require a self-consistent solution. Hybrid functionals often use a generalized Kohn–Sham form with nonlocal operators, so the local-potential expression above is not the only possible implementation. The total energy is not simply the sum of occupied orbital eigenvalues εᵢ: that would double-count some interactions and omit the corresponding corrections and internuclear energy.
若沿某方向曲率为负，则 ω² 为负，软件会把该方向标作“虚频”。分子基态极小点除: Negative curvature along a direction gives negative ω², which is represented as an imaginary frequency. A molecular ground-state minimum should have no genuinely unstable modes, apart from zero modes associated with translation and rotation. A first-order transition state is expected to have one unstable mode along the reaction direction. Small imaginary frequencies can also arise from geometry, force precision, supercell size, or violations of acoustic sum rules. Inspect the displacement pattern and convergence trends before interpreting a negative plotted frequency as material instability.

NEB places intermediate configurations between known initial and final states, maintains their spacing along the path, and seeks lower energy in directions perpendicular to it.
